## release config-template

Read a release's configuration template

Requires the `configure` action on the App. People only.

```bash
nb-studio release config-template <app> <release>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `app`     |             |
| `release` |             |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `rel.apps/configure`.

**Request:** `GET /api/releases/apps/{appId}/releases/{releaseId}/configTemplate` (`releasesGetReleaseConfigTemplate`)

## release image

Register an image release

Requires the `upload` action on the App. Registers an OCI image CI built and pushed, by digest, as a release of `version`; another platform’s image of the same version joins that release.

```bash
nb-studio release image <app> --version <string> --ref <string> --digest <string>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `app`    |             |

| Flag          | Type    | Description                                                                                               |
| ------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--deploy`    | boolean | Deploy it once registered; the answer then names the deployment (`deploymentId`).                         |
| `--version`   | string  | (required)                                                                                                |
| `--ref`       | string  | (required)                                                                                                |
| `--digest`    | string  | (required)                                                                                                |
| `--platform`  | string  |                                                                                                           |
| `--commit`    | string  |                                                                                                           |
| `--build`     | string  |                                                                                                           |
| `--label`     | json    | A label (key=value); repeat for more.                                                                     |
| `--variables` | json    | The build’s variables manifest; pass `--variables-file dist/variables.json`. (or --variables-file <path>) |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `rel.apps/upload`.

**Request:** `POST /api/releases/apps/{appId}/imageReleases` (`releasesRegisterImageRelease`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio release image crm --version 1.4.0 --ref ghcr.io/acme/crm --digest sha256:… --variables-file dist/variables.json
```

## release list

List an app's releases

Requires the `view` action on the App. `label=key=value` (repeatable) filters by label.

```bash
nb-studio release list <app>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `app`    |             |

| Flag      | Type    | Description                           |
| --------- | ------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `--page`  | integer | (default 1)                           |
| `--limit` | integer | (default 20)                          |
| `--label` | json    | A label (key=value); repeat for more. |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `id`, `version`, `createdAt`, `createdVia`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `rel.apps/view`.

**Request:** `GET /api/releases/apps/{appId}/releases` (`releasesListReleases`)

## release promote

Promote a release to another app

Requires the `view` action on this App and `upload` on `toAppId`. Copies the release into `toAppId`, or answers the release it already has with the same checksum.

```bash
nb-studio release promote <app> <release> --to <string>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `app`     |             |
| `release` |             |

| Flag      | Type   | Description                           |
| --------- | ------ | ------------------------------------- |
| `--to`    | string | (required)                            |
| `--label` | json   | A label (key=value); repeat for more. |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `rel.apps/upload`.

**Request:** `POST /api/releases/apps/{appId}/releases/{releaseId}/promote` (`releasesPromoteRelease`)

## release upload

Create an upload ticket for a build’s archive

Uploads alone: admits the build as `POST /api/builds/report` does (the same credential and commit checks, the App made already) and answers a one-time ticket: send the archive (`dist.tar.gz`) as the body of `method` `url` with exactly `headers`, and nothing of the session. The upload answers the release, which `nb-studio deploy --release` deploys later; nothing is deployed. To upload and deploy in one, use `nb-studio deploy --file`.

```bash
nb-studio release upload --app <string> --file <path>
```

| Flag           | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| -------------- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--app`        | string | The App the build is of, which `nb-studio app ensure` makes; `<app>-pr-<number>` for a pull request’s preview by convention. (required)                                                                                                                     |
| `--sha`        | string | The full commit hash the archive is built from; it must belong to the repository. (required; default from pull_request.head.sha of $GITHUB_EVENT_PATH or $GITHUB_SHA or $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_SOURCE_BRANCH_SHA or $CI_COMMIT_SHA)                              |
| `--repository` | string | The repository the commit is verified in, as `owner/repo`; when none is named, the one the App was recorded or made for, else the one whose CI key the credential is. A CI key may name only its own. (default from $GITHUB_REPOSITORY or $CI_PROJECT_PATH) |
| `--file`       | path   | The archive CI built (`dist.tar.gz`). (required; streamed to an upload ticket, at most 268435456 bytes)                                                                                                                                                     |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `rel.apps/upload`.

**Request:** `POST /api/builds/uploadTickets` (`buildsCreateUploadTicket`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio release upload --app my-app-staging --file storage/exports/dist.tar.gz
```

## release variables

Read a release's variables manifest

Requires the `view` action on the App. The variables the build declared (`dist/variables.json`); null for a build without a manifest.

```bash
nb-studio release variables <app> <release>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `app`     |             |
| `release` |             |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `rel.apps/view`.

**Request:** `GET /api/releases/apps/{appId}/releases/{releaseId}/variables` (`releasesGetReleaseVariables`)
